english.meaning: to keep saying something loudly and repeatedly
english.note: Introduces the repeated words, as in 口口聲聲：「贏啊」.

exampleSentences.english: Honestly. You keep saying, “Win, Big Waterfall, win,” but you don’t buy it yourself.
exampleSentences.traditional: 真係吖。口口聲聲：「贏啊，大瀑布，贏啊。」自己唔走去買喎。
